gaps.explanation: Report itself does not add up. Statement (trimmed p4, printed p10) Special Revenue Fund column: Property 16,233 + State receipts 67,198 + Other general receipts 36,513 = Total receipts 119,944. Departmental Analysis of Special Revenue Fund (trimmed p11, printed p23, column Street) prints Total Receipts 119,944 but its printed rows are Property tax 15,041, Homestead exemption 435, Property tax credit 757, Highway allocation 67,198, Street assessment 29,970 = 113,401 (all five already in detail). The 6,543 difference (= Other general receipts 36,513 - Street assessment 29,970) is not printed as a row in any fund column or schedule; adding it would be a derived amount, so nothing is added. General Fund schedule (p9) Total Receipts 286,215 = p4 General Fund column and is fully in detail. Debt Service Fund column: no receipts (p4 '-', p12 '-'). Statement Transfers row is '-' in every fund column (p4); no bond proceeds or other financing rows printed.

Statement (trimmed p4, printed p10) Special Revenue Fund column prints Streets 19,704, Capital outlay 44,108, Other capital outlay 90 (Total disbursements 63,902). The Street schedule (trimmed p11) prints Gravel 9,316, Professional fees 600, Supplies 3,157, Capital outlay 44,108 (= 57,181, all in detail) and Total disbursements 63,902; it has no 'Other capital outlay' row, so the printed 90 (p4, Special Revenue Fund column) is not in any detail line and is added under the fund name the schedule already uses (Street Fund; p4 heads the column 'Special Revenue Fund'). Detail 258,855 + 90 = 258,945. The remaining 6,631 (= statement Streets 19,704 - p11 object rows 13,073) is not printed as a row anywhere (the p11 schedule itself does not add up: its rows total 57,181 vs printed total 63,902); a derived figure is not added. General Fund schedule (p10) Total disbursements 201,674 = p4 General Fund column, fully in detail. Debt Service Fund: no disbursements (p4, p12).
